title: 第二十六章 蛟血开境夜斩阁中刺客第二十五章 侯主真言父辈半生局
lines: 第二十六章蛟血开境，夜斩阁中刺客
夕阳垂落，鎏金余晖铺满镇北侯府飞檐。
白日沁柳院公堂审判落幕，侯府风向彻底大变。
曾经横行府内的三房轰然崩塌，柳氏废功囚于思过崖，赵坤剥夺嫡籍等候重罚，全府上下，再无人敢欺压西落院，更无人敢轻视沈砚。
一路走回西落院，沿途值守护卫、扫地下人，尽数低头躬身行礼，敬畏藏于眼底，再无往日鄙夷与漠视。
可沈砚步履平淡，心神未起半分波澜。
敬畏也好，追捧也罢，从来不是他所求之物。
镇北侯沈苍坦诚当年权谋算计，默许三房构陷双亲，只为稳固自身侯位，因果分明，许诺平反罪名、外派斥候探查域外踪迹，恩怨已然对半抵消。
但祸根从未斩尽。
第一，青风阁永安分部全军覆没，阁内总部震怒，加之柳氏早年预付重金，已然派遣精锐杀手入阳城，必杀他以绝后患；第二，柳氏域外豢养死士私部，正是当年半路截杀父母的主力，蛰伏域外多年，战力远超府内杀手；第三，沈苍口中藏头露尾的第三方势力，当年暗中出手，推波助澜，目的至今成谜。
武徒二重，已是过往战力。
可越阶对战终究损耗极大，面对成群同境杀手、高阶武者，仅凭肉身蛮力，终究难以护住自身、护住阿禾。
想要掌控主动权，唯有破境变强。
院内，阿禾早已收拾妥当厢房，烧好温水，将院落门窗加固完毕，少年眉眼沉稳，褪去往日怯懦，守在正屋门外：“公子，院内已排查完毕，四周无潜藏眼线，可安心闭关。”
历经数次生死，他早已明白，自己能做的，便是守好后方，给沈砚一片安稳闭关之地。
“辛苦你了。”
沈砚颔首推门而入，反手合上木门，隔绝外界所有风声与人情纷扰。
屋内陈设极简，一桌一蒲团，干净朴素。
沈砚盘膝落座，掌心缓缓托起一枚碧色蛟珠，珠体温润透亮，内里残存浓郁精纯的碧鳞蛟本源气血，流转淡淡金纹，气息浑厚磅礴。
这是黑风古林斩杀碧鳞蛟所得内丹，大半本源此前用以疗伤御敌，余下三成底蕴，足够支撑他冲破武徒二重桎梏，登临三重。
武徒境界，一重聚气入脉，二重凝力于腑，三重化劲外放。
踏入武徒三重，灵力可凝劲外放，肉身筋骨完成二次蜕变，攻防兼备，放眼整个青阳城年轻一辈，已然跻身顶尖之列。
沈砚闭目凝神，摒除杂念，丹田内《碎云诀》功法自主运转，周身浅碧灵力环绕周身，经脉尽数舒展打开，静待蛟珠本源入体。
低沉震颤之声响起，蛟珠灵光轰然绽放，温润磅礴的蛟兽血气裹挟精纯灵气，化作漫天碧色丝缕，顺着周身毛孔，疯狂涌入四肢百骸。
不同于丹药灵气的暴戾驳杂，蛟血本源同源相融，顺着经脉无阻流通，直冲丹田气海。
丹田之内，原本平稳流转的二重灵力气旋，开始高速旋转、堆叠凝练，体积不断扩张，质地愈发厚重。
与此同时，潜藏骨血深处的上古蛟鳞血脉彻底苏醒，温热力量冲刷每一寸骨骼肌理，修补竹林厮杀留下的经脉暗伤，重塑肉身骨膜。
咔嚓、咔嚓、咔嚓！
体内筋骨接连响起脆响，皮肉韧性暴涨，骨骼硬度节节攀升，肉身强度再度拔高一层，寻常武徒三重兵刃，已然难以破防。
时间流逝，夜色吞没残阳，侯府入夜，二更鼓响。
屋内灵气由浓转淡，尽数被身躯吸纳殆尽，掌心蛟珠光泽彻底黯淡，沦为一枚毫无灵气的普通白石。
下一秒，丹田气海轰然震颤，桎梏壁垒轰然破碎！
武徒三重，破境而成！
内敛浑厚的灵力气场自周身散开，不狂不躁，却极具压迫感。
沈砚缓缓抬眸，眼底一抹碧芒转瞬隐去，归于澄澈平静。
五感暴涨数倍，百米外守卫低语、檐下虫鸣、远处流水之声，尽数入耳，分毫清晰。
他抬指轻弹指尖，一缕凝练青色劲气破空而出，无声无息洞穿实木桌角，孔洞平滑利落，劲气外放，完美契合三重武道特征。
“灵力底蕴提升七成，肉身逼近武徒四重，碎石诀威力翻倍，流云碎月步提速两成。”
沈砚心底自测战力，心底了然。
若是再遇竹林三名武徒二重杀手，无需近身缠斗，一指劲气便可秒杀，无需耗费半分气力。即便对战老牌武徒三重武者，自身蛟血肉身加持，亦可稳压一头。

Chapter 26 The blood of the dragon opens the realm, killing the assassin in the pavilion at night
The sun sets, and the gilded afterglow covers the eaves of the Zhenbei Hou Mansion.
During the day, the trial in Qinliu Court came to an end, and the trend of the Hou Mansion completely changed.
The three houses that once dominated the mansion suddenly collapsed, the Liu family was imprisoned in Siguo Cliff for all their efforts, and Zhao Kun was deprived of his legal status and awaited heavy punishment. No one in the whole mansion dared to bully Xiluoyuan anymore, and no one dared to despise Shen Yan.
Walking all the way back to the Xiluo Courtyard, I guarded and swept away the underground people along the way. They all lowered their heads and bowed in salute, with awe hidden in their eyes. There was no longer the contempt and indifference of the past.
But Shen Yan's steps were calm and his mind was not disturbed at all.
Whether it's awe or admiration, it's never what he wants.
The Marquis of Zhenbei, Shen Cang, was honest about his power plot and his tacit approval of Sanfang's plot to frame his parents, just to consolidate his position. The cause and effect were clear, and he promised to redress the charges and send scouts to explore the traces outside the territory. The grudges have been offset in half.
But the root of the problem was never eliminated.
First, the Yong'an branch of Qingfeng Pavilion was completely wiped out, and the headquarters in the pavilion was furious. In addition, the Liu family paid a heavy sum in advance and sent elite killers into Yangcheng to kill him to avoid future troubles; second, the Liu family raised private troops of dead soldiers outside the territory. It was the main force who intercepted and killed his parents in the past. He had been dormant outside the territory for many years, and his combat power far exceeded the killers in the house. Thirdly, the third-party force that Shen Cang said was hidden and exposed, secretly took action and added fuel to the flames, and its purpose is still a mystery.
The second level of martial arts is already a past combat strength.
However, cross-level battles were extremely costly after all. Facing hordes of fellow killers and high-level warriors, it was ultimately difficult to protect himself and Ah He with only physical brute force.
If you want to take the initiative, you can only break through the situation and become stronger.
In the courtyard, Ah He had already packed up the side room, boiled warm water, and reinforced the doors and windows of the courtyard. The young man's eyebrows were calm, and he had lost his former timidity. He stood guard outside the main door: "Sir, the investigation of the courtyard has been completed. There are no hidden spies around, so you can retreat with peace of mind."
After several lives and deaths, he has long understood that all he can do is to guard the rear and give Shen Yan a safe place to retreat.
"Thank you for your hard work."
Shen Yan nodded and pushed open the door, then closed the wooden door with his backhand to block out all the wind and human disturbances from the outside world.
The furnishings in the house are minimalist, with one table and one futon, clean and simple.
Shen Yan sat cross-legged and slowly held up a blue-colored dragon bead in his palm. The bead was moist and translucent. The rich and pure jade-scaled dragon's original energy and blood remained inside. There were faint golden lines flowing through it, and the aura was rich and majestic.
This is the inner elixir obtained from killing the Jade-scaled Jiao in the Black Wind Ancient Forest. Most of it was used to heal wounds and defend against enemies. The remaining 30% of the essence was enough to support him in breaking through the shackles of the second level of martial arts and ascending to the third level.
In the martial arts realm, the first level is to gather Qi into the meridians, the second level is to concentrate energy in the organs, and the third level is to transform energy and release it outwards.
After entering the third level of martial arts, spiritual power can be concentrated and released, the physical body and muscles have completed the second transformation, and they are both offensive and defensive. Looking at the entire young generation of Qingyang City, they are already among the top.
Shen Yan closed his eyes and concentrated, getting rid of distracting thoughts. The "Shattering Cloud Jue" technique in his dantian was operating autonomously. The light green spiritual energy around his body surrounded his whole body. All his meridians were stretched and opened, waiting for the source of the dragon bead to enter his body.
Buzz——
A low and trembling sound sounded, and the spiritual light of the dragon bead suddenly bloomed. The warm and majestic blood of the dragon beast enveloped the pure spiritual energy, turning into blue silk strands all over the sky, flowing along the pores of the whole body, and pouring into the limbs and bones crazily.
Different from the violent and mixed spiritual energy of elixirs, the dragon blood originates from the same source and blends together. It flows along the meridians without obstruction and goes straight to the sea of ​​qi in the Dantian.
Within the dantian, the two-level spiritual power cyclone that was originally flowing smoothly began to rotate at high speed, stacked and condensed, and its volume continued to expand, and its texture became thicker.
At the same time, the ancient dragon scale blood vessels hidden deep in the bones and blood were completely awakened, and the warm power washed away every inch of skeletal texture, repairing the hidden wounds on the meridians left by the fighting in the bamboo forest, and reshaping the periosteum of the physical body.
Click, click, click!
The muscles and bones in the body make crisp sounds one after another, the toughness of the skin and flesh increases sharply, the hardness of the bones increases step by step, and the strength of the physical body increases again. It is already difficult for ordinary warriors to break through the defense with three weapons.
Time passed, the night swallowed up the setting sun, the night fell in the Hou Mansion, and the second watch drum sounded.
The aura in the house turned from strong to weak, and was completely absorbed by the body. The luster of the dragon bead in the palm of his hand completely dimmed, turning into an ordinary white stone without aura.
The next second, the sea of ​​Qi in Dantian trembled, and the shackles were shattered!
The third level of martial arts, breaking through the realm!
The restrained and vigorous spiritual power aura spreads out from the whole body, neither wild nor impetuous, but extremely oppressive.
Shen Yan slowly raised his eyes, and the green light in his eyes disappeared in an instant, returning to clarity and calm.
The five senses surged several times. The whispers of the guards a hundred meters away, the chirping of insects under the eaves, and the sound of running water in the distance all came to my ears clearly.
He raised his finger and flicked his fingertips, and a wisp of condensed cyan energy burst out of the air, silently piercing the corner of the solid wood table. The holes were smooth and neat, and the energy was released, which perfectly matched the characteristics of the three levels of martial arts.
"The spiritual power base has been increased by 70%, the physical body is close to the fourth level of martial arts, the power of the Stone Crushing Technique has been doubled, and the Flowing Cloud and Moon Steps have been accelerated by 20%."
Shen Yan tested his own combat power in his heart, and he knew it in his heart.
If we meet the three second-level assassins of the martial arts disciples in the bamboo forest again, there is no need to fight in close combat. They can be killed instantly with a finger of strength without spending half a point of energy. Even if he fights against a veteran martial artist of the third level, with the blessing of his own dragon blood body, he can still hold the pressure firmly.
